subject: Web Development
title: Supply Chain Attacks
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Supply Chain Attacks.

hook.text: Modern websites depend on hundreds of third-party packages. Each one is a trust decision.

buildup.text: A supply chain attack compromises a dependency that thousands of projects rely on.

discovery.text: The event-stream npm package was hijacked in 2018 to steal Bitcoin from a specific wallet.

twist.text: The attacker gained trust by maintaining the package for months before inserting malicious code.

climax.text: Every npm install is an act of trust. Supply chain security is now a critical web concern.

punchline.text: Your dependencies are someone else's code.

quiz.question: What is a supply chain attack?
options: Compromising a dependency others rely on
